payload.words: An add writes the Goal's folder before it records the Goal, so a recorded Goal always has its folder.

lines.text: When hyp add goal cannot write the Goal's folder, it records no Goal.
A successful hyp add goal --draft NAME records the Goal open, and goals/<G>/ holds the examples whose hashes the goal.add carries.

why: #444 Goal F: F-FHBFK9, the half of F-Y5ARH5 that G-16W1RX left open; owner chose (A) the folder is never missing
